indicator_name: Renewal ratio of tangible fixed assets
methodology: Percent, renewal ratio, % (new assets put into operation / gross stock at the end of the year). Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703217.
